# \# SPEC-008 — Flow Map Runtime Support

# 

# \## Objective

# 

# Add runtime support for Flow Maps to the Stylized Water Shader.

# 

# The shader must be able to read spatially varying flow direction and flow strength from a texture generated by future tooling.

# 

# This Spec establishes the runtime data format and debug support only.

# 

# It does not create the final Flow Map baking tool.

# 

# \---

# 

# \# Dependencies

# 

# Requires completed and validated:

# 

# \- SPEC-001 through SPEC-007.

# 

# Preserve:

# 

# \- depth-based coloring;

# \- opacity;

# \- stylized pattern shaping;

# \- Flow Direction;

# \- Flow Speed;

# \- Flow Strength;

# \- uniform-flow fallback.

# 

# \---

# 

# \# Flow Map Data Convention

# 

# Use:

# 

# R = Flow Direction X  

# G = Flow Direction Y  

# B = Flow Strength  

# A = reserved for future turbulence / auxiliary data

# 

# Decode direction from texture range 0–1 into vector range -1 to +1.

# 

# Conceptually:

# 

# flowDir = flowMap.rg \* 2 - 1

# 

# Do not normalize near-zero vectors blindly.

# 

# If the decoded direction magnitude is close to zero, treat it as no directional flow.

# 

# \---

# 

# \# Required Properties

# 

# Add:

# 

# \_FlowMap

# \_UseFlowMap

# 

# Optional if technically useful:

# 

# \_FlowMapTiling

# \_FlowMapOffset

# 

# Do not expose unnecessary controls.

# 

# \---

# 

# \# Uniform Flow Fallback

# 

# When Flow Map is disabled:

# 

# continue using:

# 

# \_FlowDirection

# \_FlowStrength

# 

# Do not remove uniform flow.

# 

# It remains useful for:

# 

# \- waterfalls;

# \- simple channels;

# \- debugging;

# \- fallback.

# 

# \---

# 

# \# Flow Strength Integration

# 

# Flow Map B must feed the existing SPEC-007 Flow Strength system.

# 

# Do not create a second unrelated strength implementation.

# 

# Local strength should continue affecting:

# 

# \- speed;

# \- stretch;

# \- pattern visibility;

# \- coverage/threshold behavior.

# 

# \---

# 

# \# Debug Modes

# 

# Add technical debug visualization for:

# 

# \## Flow Direction

# 

# Visualize decoded RG direction clearly.

# 

# \## Flow Strength

# 

# Visualize the B channel clearly.

# 

# Debug modes must not be enabled by default.

# 

# \---

# 

# \# Temporary Test Data

# 

# A temporary technical Flow Map may be generated procedurally or by editor code for validation.

# 

# Do not require an artist-authored final PNG.

# 

# The long-term goal is for future tools to generate this data automatically.

# 

# \---

# 

# \# Texture/Data Requirements

# 

# Flow Map data must be treated as linear data.

# 

# Use:

# 

# \- sRGB Off;

# \- no destructive color-space conversion.

# 

# For technical test textures, prefer:

# 

# \- Compression None;

# \- Filter Bilinear.

# 

# Do not rely on lossy compression for validation.

# 

# \---

# 

# \# Validation

# 

# Confirm:

# 

# \- uniform fallback still works;

# \- Flow Map mode can be enabled/disabled;

# \- RG direction decodes correctly;

# \- B drives local Flow Strength;

# \- calm and fast regions can coexist on one surface;

# \- debug direction matches source data;

# \- debug strength matches source data;

# \- depth coloring and opacity remain functional.

# 

# \---

# 

# \# External Assets

# 

# No permanent artist-created Flow Map is required.

# 

# Temporary generated test data is allowed.

# 

# Do not add:

# 

# \- foam textures;

# \- normal maps;

# \- distortion textures;

# \- new water noise textures.

# 

# \---

# 

# \# Acceptance Criteria

# 

# SPEC-008 is complete when:

# 

# \- the shader supports runtime Flow Map sampling;

# \- direction varies spatially;

# \- Flow Strength varies spatially;

# \- uniform flow remains available;

# \- debug views verify decoded data;

# \- existing systems remain functional.

# 

# \---

# 

# \# Out of Scope

# 

# Do not implement:

# 

# \- dual-phase advection;

# \- curved-flow stability;

# \- Flow Map baking tools;

# \- collider analysis;

# \- automatic strength generation;

# \- foam;

# \- waves;

# \- reflection;

# \- refraction;

# \- VFX.
